title: Bim modeler
description:
Confira a vaga para Bim modeler em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

BIM Modeler – Fire Protection / Sprinkler Systems (US Projects) | Revit MEP | 100% Remote LATAM 100% REMOTE OPPORTUNITY FOR LATAM AEC PROFESSIONALS!  Work directly with leading US-based engineering & construction firms.    Competitive Pay in USD | Full-Time (NY Schedule) | 100% Remote (Brazil)    We are hiring a BIM Modeler / Specialist focused on Fire Protection & Sprinkler Systems to join the design team of one of our U. S.-based construction clients in New York.  In this role, you will work directly with the client’s engineering team to develop detailed fire sprinkler shop drawings, build 3 D models using Revit MEP and Auto Sprink, and ensure full compliance with NFPA standards. This is an ideal position for Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineers with hands-on experience in fire protection design (RCI/PCI) and BIM coordination.      What We Offer 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in LATAM directly for a U. S. client. USD Compensation: Competitive rate with direct international payment. Full-Time: Monday–Friday (New York / EST Schedule). 18 PTO Days: Flexible paid time off for personal use. Professional Growth: Direct exposure to U. S. building codes, NFPA standards, and advanced BIM workflows.    What You’ll Do Develop detailed 3 D models and construction-ready shop drawings using Revit MEP and Auto Sprink . Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U. S. projects. Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs. Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks . Proactively review plans to identify design conflicts and develop practical engineering solutions before construction. Conduct QA/QC reviews to eliminate modeling errors and maintain organized project documentation/revisions.    What You’ll Bring English Level: Advanced Technical & Conversational English (B2+ / C1). Experience: 3+ years of experience in fire protection design, fire sprinkler modeling, or RCI/PCI systems. Core Software: Expert proficiency in Revit MEP (mandatory); strong experience with Auto Sprink is highly preferred. US Standards: Deep knowledge of NFPA standards (NFPA 13) and U. S. fire protection practices. Education: Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical design experience. Problem-Solving: Strong technical background with high attention to detail and ability to work independently.    Tools & Key Skills Tools: Revit MEP • Auto Sprink • Navisworks • Auto CAD Technical Areas: Fire Sprinkler Design • Fire Protection Systems • RCI / PCI • NFPA 13 • BIM Modeling • MEP Coordination • Shop Drawings • Clash Detection    Similar Search Terms / Target Profiles  BIM Modeler • Fire Protection BIM Designer • Fire Sprinkler Specialist • Revit MEP Designer – Fire Protection • Ingeniero RCI / PCI • Diseñador de Sistemas Contra Incendios • Fire Protection Engineer • Sprinkler Designer      About Cresta  At Cresta, we connect top AEC professionals across Latin America with leading engineering and construction companies in the U. S. You will work as a dedicated, full-time member of our client's team, collaborating directly on real-world U. S. projects while Cresta supports your ongoing onboarding and HR experience.      Ready to model safer projects for the US market? Apply now and elevate your career!  Note: Only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

title: Supervisor técnico de tubulação
description:
Nova oportunidade para Supervisor técnico de tubulação em barueri. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Gruen      Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.    Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.    Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.    Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.    Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.      Supervisor Técnico de Tubulação      Atribuições Coordenar e fiscalizar as equipes terceirizadas responsáveis pela montagem de tubulações e equipamentos. Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de campo, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e metas do projeto. Verificar a conformidade dos serviços executados com desenhos, isométricos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos de montagem. Acompanhar a instalação de tubulações, suportes, válvulas, acessórios e equipamentos associados aos sistemas de gás. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SSMA/QSMS), promovendo uma cultura de trabalho seguro. Realizar inspeções de campo, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas para assegurar a qualidade da execução. Coordenar a interface entre as equipes de engenharia, planejamento, inspeção, segurança, operação e empresas contratadas. Acompanhar testes de pressão, estanqueidade e demais atividades de comissionamento relacionadas aos sistemas de tubulação. Controlar o avanço físico das obras, elaborar relatórios técnicos e registrar ocorrências relevantes. Validar medições dos serviços executados pelas empresas terceirizadas, quando aplicável. Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos durante a execução das atividades, buscando soluções que minimizem impactos no cronograma. Assegurar a correta utilização de materiais, equipamentos e recursos disponibilizados para a obra. Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, fornecedores e empresas contratadas, apresentando o status das atividades e os principais indicadores.    Qualificações Cursos técnicos em Mecânica, Tubulação Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em coordenação e fiscalização de empresas terceirizadas de montagem industrial. Vivência em projetos de redes de distribuição de gás, gasodutos, city gates ou plantas industriais. Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, P& ID, isométricos e fluxogramas. Conhecimento das normas ASME B31.3, ASME B31.8, API 1104, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35 e demais normas aplicáveis ao setor. Experiência com testes hidrostáticos, pneumáticos, testes de estanqueidade e atividades de comissionamento. title: Short-form video editor
description:

Short-Form Video Editor – Social Media & Content      Location: Remote    Type: Full-Time    Schedule: 40 hours/week      About the Client      Our client is a marketing and creative agency that helps brands grow through a combination of digital marketing, social media, content creation, video production, paid media, and creative design .    The agency works with brands across different industries, developing engaging, social-first content designed to build audiences, increase brand visibility, and support business growth.    The team is currently expanding its video production capabilities to support a new college-focused social app . The project will involve creating authentic, engaging short-form content featuring college campuses, student conversations, street interviews, and promotional material.      About the Role      We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor to join the creative team and support the launch of a new social app designed for college students.    The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form social media content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, Tik Tok, and You Tube Shorts.    You will work with raw footage, often recorded on phones or other lightweight equipment, and turn it into polished, engaging content that feels natural to a young U. S. audience.    A strong understanding of social media culture, Gen Z content, pacing, storytelling, and current short-form video trends is important for this role.    Candidates with previous experience editing street interviews, man-on-the-street content, campus videos, interviews, UGC, or youth-oriented social content are especially encouraged to apply.      Key Responsibilities     Edit short-form videos for Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, and other social platforms. Turn raw phone-shot and camera footage into polished, engaging social content. Edit college campus tours, street interviews, student conversations, promotional videos, and UGC-style content. Review large amounts of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, reactions, quotes, and answers. Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds. Build a clear and engaging story from multiple clips. Use jump cuts, hard cuts, B-roll, and pacing to maintain viewer attention. Cut footage to music and beats when appropriate. Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, and other social-first elements. Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup. Maintain consistency in visual quality, pacing, and editing style across content. Repurpose footage into multiple short-form pieces when appropriate. Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently. Manage a high volume of content during the app's launch period. Potentially support video projects for other agency clients as the role develops.    Requirements     Proven experience editing short-form social media content . Strong proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable Adobe video-editing software. Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual rhythm. Ability to turn raw footage into engaging short-form content. Experience with basic color correction and audio editing. Ability to work effectively with phone-shot, raw, and imperfect footage. Good understanding of Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form formats. Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines. Ability to work independently while taking direction and incorporating feedback. Strong English communication skills.    Preferred Qualifications     Previous experience editing street interviews or man-on-the-street videos . Experience with college, campus, student, Gen Z, lifestyle, dating, social, or UGC content. Experience editing interviews and multi-person conversations. Experience working with high-volume social media content. Familiarity with Adobe After Effects . Basic motion graphics and animation skills. Experience creating engaging captions and animated text. Strong awareness of current Tik Tok and Instagram editing trends.    The ideal candidate knows how to:     Start with a strong hook. Remove unnecessary pauses, filler, and dead space. Keep conversations moving with natural cuts and jump cuts. Identify the funniest, most interesting, surprising, or relatable moments. Combine multiple interview responses into a cohesive story. Use B-roll strategically. Add clean, readable captions. Use music and sound effects when they enhance the content. Keep the content authentic and conversational. Avoid excessive transitions, effects, and animations when they don't add value.

Banco de Talentos - PCD      Sany no Mundo      Trabalhando no Futuro. Quer participar desse futuro, então conheça Sany.    A SANY é uma empresa voltada para o futuro que nasceu em uma época de mudanças e agora busca qualquer oportunidade nessas mudanças que abrirão o caminho para o futuro.    Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, a visão da SANY de construir uma empresa de primeira classe, promover funcionários de primeira classe e fazer contribuições de primeira classe para a sociedade.    Temos nos concentrado em agregar valor aos clientes, funcionários, acionistas e ao público, oferecendo produtos e serviços de alta qualidade,    Proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho cheio de oportunidades, divulgando relatórios financeiros para atender às expectativas dos investidores e exercendo nossa própria influência para ajudar os necessitados.    Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.    Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.      Sany do Brasil      No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².    Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.    Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.    No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.    A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filial própria pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.    E agora a Sany está com novos planos para o Brasil. Breves Novidades

title: Arquitetura de soluções azure - 134713
description:

O que buscamos:    Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.    Responsabilidades:   Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do Zero Layer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios   Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture Terraform para Ia C multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos.    Desejável:   Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS Argo CD (Git Ops), incluindo Application Sets para deploy em múltiplas células Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e m TLS inter-serviço Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes.    Descrição comportamental:    Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico. Cloud Co E Solution Architect GCP - Sao Paulo-Guararema      Mars is a $50 B+ global powerhouse driving the next generation of digital transformation. We are a family-owned business operating in 80+ countries with over 150,000 Associates. Guided by our Five Principles— Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom —we are currently embarking on a massive Digital Core program to modernize our global technology landscape and build the future of our enterprise cloud capabilities.      When you join Mars, you join a purpose-driven company where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.      The Opportunity    As a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCo E) Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in driving the design, architecture, and delivery of cloud solutions for the entire organization. You will collaborate with a global team of architects to develop and implement Mars’ platforms and cloud-based systems that power our operations every day.    Working within the CCo E Client Solutions team, you will act as a bridge between cloud architects, enterprise architecture, security, and business stakeholders. Your mission will be to develop services, establish landing zones, and design secure, scalable architectures for high-impact, unique digital projects.      Key Responsibilities    In this role, you will balance technical excellence with collaborative enablement. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:   Architectural Design & Blueprinting: Assess business demands and technical requirements to create robust, highly available, and fault-tolerant Low-Level Designs (LLDs). Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Lead the implementation of cloud solutions utilizing modern Ia C practices (Git, Terraform) to automate and scale deployments. Scalability & Performance: Design and architect systems that support elasticity, ensuring cost-optimizations and peak performance. Security & Compliance: Ensure all solutions align strictly with the Mars Cloud Adoption Framework, Security Principles, and Well-Architected Frameworks. Collaboration & Leadership: Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) in the CCo E for customer LLD/Deployment Projects, guiding cross-functional design discussions and contributing to the service catalog's evolution. Cloud Advocacy: Act as a Cloud Ambassador across Mars, promoting cloud adoption, sharing best practices, and mentoring other technical teams.    What We Are Looking For    Core Technical Skills & Experience (Must-Haves): Proven GCP Expertise: Hands-on experience architecting and deploying enterprise-grade solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its primary services. Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Strong experience deploying cloud infrastructure via Terraform and managing workflows with Git. Solution Design & Integration: Deep proficiency in application architecture, system integration, data modeling, and designing for high availability/disaster recovery. Software Engineering Foundation: In-depth knowledge of modern software development principles, methodologies, and enterprise architectures. Security Mindset: Practical understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management (IAM), data protection, and compliance standards.  Leadership & Soft Skills: Stakeholder Management: Experience translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences. Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of driving clarity in ambiguous environments. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, multicultural, and global teams.    Nice-to-Haves: Experience with other major cloud platforms (such as Microsoft Azure or AWS). Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF). Professional GCP certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Security Engineer).    What to Expect in This Role Balancing Speed and Governance: The Cloud Co E is an enabler, not a bottleneck. Your success means building robust landing zones that protect our enterprise systems while empowering developers to innovate at pace. Complex Multi-Stakeholder Collaboration: You will regularly coordinate between software developers, security officers, and business leaders. Clear, jargon-free communication is your primary tool for aligning vision.    What Can You Expect from Mars? Collaborative Culture: Work with diverse, talented, and highly supportive Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Continuous Learning: Access to best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including our in-house Mars University and specialized cloud certification pathways. Competitive Compensation: An industry-competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including a performance-based company bonus. Global Impact: The opportunity to work on projects that directly influence a global scale, touching millions of lives every day.    Equal Opportunity Employer    Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.    If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Arquitetura e operação em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, GCP e/ou OCI); Infraestrutura como Código — Ia C (Terraform ou equivalente); Pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Argo CD ou similares); Conteinerização e orquestração (Docker e Kubernetes); Segurança em nuvem: IAM, gestão de vulnerabilidades e conformidade; Machine Learning aplicado: treinamento, validação e implantação de modelos.    Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Agentic AI / LLM Ops — agentes de IA para automação de workflows; AIOps — detecção de anomalias e monitoramento inteligente; Fin Ops — otimização de custos em nuvem e Predictive Autoscaling; Policy-as-Code (Open Policy Agent, Sentinel ou similares); Arquiteturas de auto-healing e failover automatizado multi-cloud; Publicações acadêmicas em Dev Sec Ops, MLOps ou infraestrutura autônoma. Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua envolvendo armazenagem, abastecimento de linha, movimentação interna, sequenciamento de produção, recebimento de materiais e fluxo de informações; Realizar estudos de dimensionamento de recursos, balanceamento operacional, capacidade produtiva, utilização de mão de obra, equipamentos logísticos e ocupação de armazenagem, propondo soluções para maximizar a eficiência da operação; Desenvolver dashboards, indicadores e ferramentas gerenciais que suportem o monitoramento da performance logística e a tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Atuar na implementação, melhoria e governança dos sistemas logísticos (SAP, MES, JIS e sistemas correlatos), garantindo aderência aos processos operacionais; Conduzir análises de causa raiz utilizando metodologias estruturadas de solução de problemas, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas de alto impacto; Elaborar apresentações executivas para a liderança, comunicando resultados, análises, riscos, oportunidades e planos de ação de forma clara e objetiva; Atuar como agente de transformação digital da logística, disseminando novas tecnologias, metodologias e melhores práticas para toda a organização; Garantir que todas as melhorias sejam desenvolvidas considerando Segurança, Ergonomia, Qualidade, Custos, Produtividade e Sustentabilidade. title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us      Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

business communication skills Ability to coordinate RFQs, quotations, suppliers, and project opportunities Good English communication skills    Preferred Skills   Experience in sales or business system integrators, distributors, contractors, or enterprise customers Experience supporting RFQs, tenders, quotations, or project-based sales Understanding of FTTx, data center interconnection, Requisitos Desejáveis Experiência em operações de crédito, cobrança ou recuperação de ativos no agronegócio; Vivência em fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs, instituições financeiras, empresas de insumos ou gestoras de crédito; Conhecimento sobre operações estruturadas, direitos creditórios, cessão de crédito e garantias agrícolas; Familiaridade com CPRs, duplicatas, penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão fiduciária, garantias reais e pessoais; Experiência na gestão de escritórios jurídicos, consultorias e fornecedores especializados; Conhecimento em inteligência artificial, automação e análise de dados aplicadas à cobrança; Vivência com Legal Ops, sistemas de cobrança, CRMs ou plataformas de gestão de carteiras; Pós-graduação em Finanças, Gestão, Agronegócio, Direito Empresarial ou áreas correlatas.    Competências Esperadas Liderança com forte orientação para execução; Visão estratégica e pensamento sistêmico; Capacidade de tomar decisões em ambientes de pressão e incerteza; Profundidade analítica e domínio de indicadores; Excelente capacidade de negociação; Comunicação clara, firme e executiva; Disciplina de processos e atenção à qualidade; Senso de urgência e capacidade de priorização; Protagonismo, autonomia e responsabilidade; Capacidade de construir soluções em ambientes em desenvolvimento; Facilidade para transitar entre negócio, jurídico, operação e tecnologia; Orientação para resultado sem comprometer governança e segurança jurídica. title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Crypto operations specialist em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us    Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.    About the role    Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.    What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.  What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.  Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.  What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.     Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R& D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.    Industries & Applications    Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T — Connected appliances, energy management, security.    Why Quectel LATAM? Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.    Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off.
